header: Several quotes, all visible at once
lead: Two to twelve quote cards in two, three or four columns. The names line up at the bottom of each row, however long the quotes are.

quotes.quote_text: Each card is a figure: the quote in a blockquote, the name in a caption, and a portrait if you upload one.
